title: Clinical evaluation of large language model recommendations in melanoma: comparison with multidisciplinary tumor board decisions in a real-world cohort.
summary: Recommendations were compared with real MDT decisions and independent oncologist ratings. The result is reported in the Frontiers in Oncology. It does not establish generalization beyond the reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
ai_technology: Four LLMs generated melanoma-treatment recommendations for 151 retrospective MDT cases.
